description.value: Curry Express is a family-run quick serve Indian restaurant chain that has been serving the Vancouver area since 1996, with locations inside Metropolis at Metrotown, Lougheed Town Centre, and CF Richmond Centre. The menu draws on North Indian traditions, featuring biryanis, karhai curries, tandoori wraps, and street food specialties like samosa chaat and chole kulche, all prepared fresh using quality meats and produce cooked in tandoor ovens and traditional vessels. The mall food court setting makes it a convenient hot meal stop for cyclists passing through Burnaby or Richmond.
